profile_time_context_manager: use the profile_time context manager to measure CPU and GPU time spent in a code block
profile_gpu_operation: profile a GPU tensor operation using profile_time to print elapsed CPU and GPU milliseconds
profile_model_forward_pass: wrap a model forward pass with profile_time to benchmark inference latency on CUDA
profile_data_loading: profile data loading and preprocessing code with profile_time to identify CPU bottlenecks
profile_custom_cuda_stream: use profile_time with a custom CUDA stream to measure timing on a specific GPU stream
